description:
Assemble a ready-to-paste prompt that primes any coding agent to AUDIT a URL or repo for accessibility — the test-side counterpart to a11y_build_prompt's build-side. Classifies the target (repo path, internal/intranet, or public-facing external), picks the right audit tool by default (a11y_audit_axe — the audit of record — for single pages; a11y_crawl_audit for multi-page crawls; a11y_audit_axe with scope="internal" plus a11y_audit_html for repo previews), and appends the mandatory release-gate step and the curated practical references. This is the same builder Malimbe's UI audit tools use — identical output either way.

Use this when a user is about to ask an agent to check something for accessibility and you want the request to name the right tool and end in a verdict, rather than an ad hoc scan.

Args:
  - target (string): URL or repo path to audit.
  - kind ('auto'|'repo'|'internal'|'external'): defaults to auto-detecting from target.
  - crawl, max_pages: multi-page crawl instead of a single page.
  - wcag_level, platform: conformance level and manual-verification considerations.
  - provenance_kind / provenance_ref / source_pattern: what's being audited and what design-system pattern it's checked against.
  - include_mcp_setup, agent: payload shaping.

Returns: a single prompt string.

agent.description: Target coding agent — only affects the MCP setup snippet's syntax.

crawl.description: Crawl same-origin pages instead of auditing a single page. Ignored when kind resolves to 'repo'.

include_mcp_setup.description: Include MCP tool setup naming the specific tools this prompt calls.

kind.description: Force a classification, or 'auto' to detect it from `target` (filesystem path/owner-repo slug = repo; loopback/RFC1918/.local/.internal/.test/single-label host = internal; otherwise external).

max_pages.description: Only used when crawl is true.

platform.description: Target platform — adds the relevant manual-verification considerations.

provenance_kind.description: Provenance of the audited artifact, for the release-gate step. Omit if unknown — the prompt will ask the agent to supply one.

provenance_ref.description: Reference for the provenance (URL, pkg@version, or repo@SHA).

source_pattern.description: Design-system source to check rendered widgets against (passed to a11y_audit_axe's source_pattern), for internal/repo targets.

target.description: The URL or repo path to audit.

wcag_level.description: WCAG 2.2 conformance level to audit against.

name: a11y_build_audit_prompt
title: Build an accessibility-audit prompt
